# Patliputra VinFast

> Bihar's first authorised VinFast electric vehicle dealership, located in Patna,
> Bihar, India. We sell, service and support the full VinFast EV lineup for
> customers across all 38 districts of Bihar.

Company: Patliputra VinFast
Location: Plot No. 2421, NH 30, Bypass Road, Paijawa, Patna, Bihar 800009, India
Phone: +91 92314 45060
Website: https://patliputravinfast.in
Hours: Monday-Saturday, 10:00-20:00 IST

## Products

- VinFast VF6 — compact electric SUV, 5 seats. Variants: Earth, Wind, Wind Infinity. Up to 468 km MIDC range, 59.6 kWh battery, DC fast charging up to 100 kW.
- VinFast VF7 — premium electric SUV, 5 seats. Variants: Earth, Wind, Wind Infinity, Sky, Sky Infinity. ADAS, panoramic roof, OTA updates, connected tech.
- VinFast VF MPV7 — premium 7-seater electric MPV for families and corporate fleets.
- VinFast Limo Green — practical 7-seater electric MPV for fleet operators and families.
